request.style: English, solo female voice with ethereal choir, Celtic harp, bodhran, fiddle, flute, soft piano, majestic and hopeful, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
For the choir director this is set
Of David, to bring remembrance
God, come and rescue me now
LORD, hurry to my help

[Chorus]
Let all who seek you rejoice
And be glad in you always
Let those who love your salvation
Always say let God be magnified

[Verse]
Those who say aha aha
Will be turned back by shame
Let those who delight in ruin
Be driven back in disgrace

[Chorus]
Let all who seek you rejoice
And be glad in you always
Let those who love your salvation
Always say let God be magnified

[Bridge]
I am poor and needy here
God, hurry to me now
You are my help and deliverer
LORD, do not delay

[Chorus]
Let all who seek you rejoice
And be glad in you always
Let those who love your salvation
Always say let God be magnified

[Outro]
Let God be magnified
Hurry to my help
